bibl.title: Beyond Palaeography: Text, Paratext and Dating of Early Christian Papyri.
bibl.seg: Tommy Wasserman, Beyond Palaeography: Text, Paratext and Dating of Early Christian Papyri.

Garrick Vernon Allen, Kelsie Gayle Rodenbiker, Anthony Philip Royle, Jill Unkel & Usama Ali Mohamed Gad (edd.), The Chester Beatty Biblical Papyri at Ninety. Literature, Papyrology, Ethics = Manuscripta Biblica. 10 (Berlin - New York, 2023) pp. 143-154, figg.
bibl.note: 1. Introduction: The battle over the papyri. - 2. The battle over palaeography (and dating). - 3. The Jewish roots of Christian reading and scribal practices. - 4. Textual divisions by means of ekthesis and paragraphos in biblical manuscripts. - 5. The date and character of the B-text of Codex Vaticanus. - 6. Conclusions.
